A blank that prints its OWN text in unembedded Helvetica inside a declared box reads as stamped and FAILs (the safe direction) — narrow that box. The CT, HI and SC blanks embed every font they print.
Lines without coordinates (hand_written_lines) are not on the PDF and are not checked.
